feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 29 May 2026 11:48am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 29 May 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over Germany, transferring southeast. Large and slow-moving area of low pressure in the mid-Atlantic.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4, occasionally 5 during this evening, backing south-southwest or south overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mostly slight later today.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or south-southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5, soon increasing more generally 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, then occasionally 6 in southern and central parts of the area later in the evening and early in the night. Gradually veering and decreasing west or southwest 3 or 4 by Sunday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate for a time tomorrow evening and night.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then outbreaks of rain or drizzle spreading from the west, petering out overnight. Fog becoming established early in the night.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in the rain or drizzle, occasionally poor in fog.
